candidate.answerReason: The three numbers are 24, 26, and 28. They are consecutive even numbers and sum to 78.

methods.label: Middle-number equation
methods.explanation: Let the middle even number be \(x\). Then the other two are \(x-2\) and \(x+2\). Setting up the equation \((x-2)+x+(x+2)=78\) gives \(x=26\), so the largest number is 28.
methods.levelReason: Representing consecutive even numbers and simplifying a linear equation are within Grade 7.
